title: Zwölfjährige bei Unfall mit E-Scooter verletzt

extraction.summaryEn: A car and an e-scooter collided at a crossing in Niederschönhausen, reportedly after the scooter rider crossed on red. A 12-year-old girl and her 38-year-old mother on the scooter were injured; the 73-year-old car driver was unhurt.
